parameters.question: Compare two Golden Gate assembled plasmid construct maps (CSV). The assembled sequence must match the reference exactly (ignoring case); part names and coordinate columns may appear in a different column order or row order. Verify each part's start/end positions and the final circular construct sequence are equivalent.

Golden Gate assembly of dna_parts.fasta with BsaI (GGTCTC, cuts 1 nt downstream on sense strand), parts ligated in file order part1_promoter -> part2_gene -> part3_terminator -> part4_backbone into a circular plasmid map. Verify the alternative reports the SAME total circular construct length and the SAME start-end positional interval for each of the four parts as the reference (equivalently, identical part lengths and boundaries). Differences in label wording, column/field formatting, ordering of annotation lines, whitespace, and any extra commentary are acceptable. Any mismatch in total length or in a part's coordinate interval is a failure.
